description: LegalZoom provides online legal services and legal information for consumers and small businesses, including business formation, attorney plans, trademarks, legal templates, and related workflows. Its site also publishes AI capability documentation and callable MCP endpoints for supported assistants.
summary: LegalZoom exposes MCP servers on legalzoom.com: one public default endpoint and OAuth-protected assistant-specific endpoints for Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini; no public REST, GraphQL, or CLI surface was found on legalzoom.com.
